name: Next Match
author: tsubaie
description: Your team's next fixture in the bar, counting down to kick-off.

barWidget.description: Your team's next fixture in the bar, counting down to kick-off.

schema.label: Data source
schema.description: Where fixtures come from. TheSportsDB is free, needs no key of your own, and covers leagues api-football's free tier locks away — including the Saudi Pro League. Choose api-football only if you have a paid key: its free plan cannot read the current season, so it cannot answer this widget's question at all.

schema.label: API key (optional)
schema.description: Only needed for api-football, where it is required. TheSportsDB works without one on its shared test key; supply your own TheSportsDB key here if you have one and want your own rate limit. Paste it, or keep it out of shell.json with file:~/.config/omarchy/next-match.key or env:API_FOOTBALL_KEY. Either way it is never passed on a command line, where any local user could read it out of ps.

schema.label: Team ID
schema.description: Numeric team id, from whichever source you picked — they are different numbers. Use the search box in the widget's own settings panel to find it by name.

schema.label: Show the score while the match is on
schema.description: The pill becomes a live scoreline once the match kicks off, and polls every 5 minutes while it runs. Off leaves it on the kick-off label and spends nothing extra, which is the setting to pick if you would rather not know before you watch it back.

schema.label: Base refresh
schema.description: Minutes between checks when the next match is more than a day away. This is only a floor: the widget already slows to 6 hours when nothing is close and tightens to 15 minutes near kick-off, so the free plan's 100 requests a day is never in danger. Raise it if you share a key across machines.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Glyph shown before the label. Any emoji or Nerd Font glyph.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is scheduled
schema.description: Off-season and international breaks leave no fixture to show. On, the widget takes no space at all until one appears, rather than sitting there saying so.

schema.label: Fixture query
schema.description: How the next fixture is asked for. 'next' is one request and exactly the right answer, but the free plan does not accept it. The widget detects that refusal on its own and drops to 'range' (this season plus a date window) and then 'season' (the whole season, filtered locally), remembering what worked — so you should not need to touch this. Set it by hand only to pin a mode.
